address: 16F, Waldorf Astoria Hotel, 18 Linyao Road, Pudong, Shanghai, Chinese Mainland
bio: The archway lined in porcelain art is the prelude to a sophisticated dining experience in a swish interior with the bonus of spectacular river views. In addition to Minnan classics, the menu also features some novelty recipes with creative twists. Crispy eel is air-dried before being deep-fried and dressed in honey with three types of lemons, imparting fruity and citrusy aromas. Round off with dimpled sticky rice balls in brown sugar syrup and sesame.
